title: Cost optimization: Reduce payment-service memory allocation
author: deploy-bot
body:
As part of our cost optimization initiative, reducing memory limits for payment-service.

Current usage shows average memory at ~400MB, so reducing from 2Gi to 512Mi should be safe.

**Cost savings**: ~$300/month

title: Fix payment processor timeout handling
author: alice
body:
Fixes timeout issues when payment processors are slow to respond.

Adds retry logic with exponential backoff.

title: Add payment processing metrics
author: bob
body: Adds prometheus metrics for payment processing duration and success rates.
